_about: The owner's recorded layout measurements (see LAYOUT.md). check-layout.mjs reports when any of these snippets is no longer in its file. Update this only when the owner agrees to a new measurement.

checks.name: Page / nav width value
checks.means: max-w-page = 992px (62rem), shared by the nav bar and the page content area

checks.name: Page content area (every signed-in page)
checks.snippet: <main className="mx-auto w-full max-w-page flex-1 px-4 py-6 sm:px-6 has-[[data-wide-page]]:max-w-[calc(50vw+31rem)]">
checks.means: max 992px wide (roster editor, Tracking and the session workbench, which render <WidePage />: max (window + 992px) / 2, edges halfway between the nav edges and the window edges); 16px side padding on phones, 24px from 640px up; 24px top and bottom

checks.name: Nav bar contents
checks.snippet: <nav className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-page items-center gap-2 px-4 sm:px-6" aria-label="Main">
checks.means: 56px tall; contents max 992px wide; 16px / 24px side padding; 8px between items

checks.name: Nav bar while loading
checks.snippet: <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 max-w-page items-center px-4 sm:px-6">
checks.means: same size as the nav bar: 56px tall, max 992px, 16px / 24px padding

checks.name: Mobile sidebar
